summary: Kavita is a self-hosted server designed for organising and reading digital literature, including e-books, comics, manga, and PDFs through a web interface. It includes built-in user management, rating systems, and metadata fetching to help you maintain a structured digital library. The application can be installed on various platforms and supports containerised deployments.
goodFor: It is well-suited for individuals with large collections of digital reading material who want a centralised, web-accessible reading platform with multiple user accounts.
watchOut: Depending on the size of your library and metadata requirements, initial scanning and indexing can consume significant server resources.
deployNotes: You will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your library files and database storage, alongside a reverse proxy to handle HTTPS traffic.
